The Treatment

What Are
Skin Boosters?

Skin boosters are injectable treatments containing hyaluronic acid — a molecule naturally found in the skin that holds up to 1000 times its weight in water. Unlike dermal fillers that add volume, skin boosters work by deeply hydrating the skin from within.

Once injected into the superficial skin layers, the hyaluronic acid binds water molecules and improves the skin's ability to retain moisture. The result is noticeably improved skin texture, radiance, elasticity and overall quality.

Skin boosters are particularly effective for dull, dehydrated, or crepey skin, and make an excellent maintenance treatment between other procedures.

The Process

How It Works

A precise, personalised procedure delivered at our Winslow clinic.

1

Consultation

Nafisa assesses your skin quality, hydration levels and concerns. She'll discuss which skin booster product is most appropriate and how many sessions are recommended.

2

Preparation

A topical anaesthetic cream is applied for comfort. The skin is cleansed and the treatment areas mapped.

3

Injection

The skin booster is administered via a series of small, shallow injections across the treatment area. Sessions take approximately 30–45 minutes.

4

Immediate Aftercare

Small bumps at injection sites are normal and resolve within 12–24 hours. Some mild redness may be present for a short time.

5

Results & Maintenance

Initial improvement is visible within 1–2 weeks. A course of 2–3 sessions is recommended, with maintenance every 4–6 months.
